checks.name: held-out-learning-law
checks.command: cargo test --manifest-path truelearner/Cargo.toml -p truelearner-core --test harness_boundary strengthened_path_fires_on_later_input -- --exact

findings: The shared contract has no normal dependency on either organism implementation; legacy lowering remains private to the core integration test.

The old harness passes quiet, local action, distant rejection, consequence-driven retained learning, later surface-only reuse, checkpoint replay, observer purity, construction-order, cause, locality, and dormant-part cases.
The unchanged historical learning law independently confirms that a strengthened path fires from later surface input alone.
residual_uncertainty: This verifies the old-harness oracle only; behavioral equality with the new body requires a separate adapter running these exact scenarios.
The initial catalog is a representative learning contract rather than a port of every historical protocol arm.
Four unrelated Clippy warnings remain in pre-existing dirty production files; the new contract and legacy adapter have independent strict warning gates.
